dimensions.reason: The definition relation links the retention duty to the exact record definition; C-3 and the stated intent preserve notice text together with receipt metadata.

The technical criteria retain duration, receipt rather than draft time, notice-plus-timestamp storage, limiting language, public-service scope and household exclusion. Timing and preservation subclauses are cited. However ER source references omit the actual definition and scope chunks while its applicability guidance cites the scope provision; a cross-reference sentence is not the source material it incorporates. The non-repository LegalRule also uses circular applicability rather than preserving the global public-service/household limitation.

The temporary-record exception is attached only to retention, represented in C-5 and investigation/evidence guidance, and cites its exact source. The separate in-person duty remains independently operative with an empty exceptions array and no reverse exception relation.

Packet context relations follow definition, scope, exception and timing within one corpus, but ER own source refs omit definition/scope despite those provisions materially affecting the complete technical assessment contract.

The external annual in-person appointment/attendance duty is retained as NON_ASSESSABLE without an EngineeringRule or invented technical evidence; its organizer-register context remains visible in the non-assessable rationale.
All actual authored references resolve to the exact accepted hashes and locators in the single immutable corpus. Pin correctness does not supply omitted source references.
